scope: native command parser and execution graph

supported.limitations: Quotes group words and are removed by the parser. Quote origin is not retained for later expansion.
Each stage is a simple command; typed data pipes use data mode.
File-descriptor prefixes, descriptor duplication, here-documents, and here-strings are unsupported.
The background marker must terminate the command list.
Only AND/OR short-circuit connectors are supported; semicolon-separated lists are unsupported.
Only NAME=value assignments are accepted; shell export flags and bare-name export are unsupported.

unsupported.diagnostic: unsupported Bash/Zsh construct: advanced file-descriptor or here-document redirection
unsupported Bash/Zsh construct: command or process substitution

forms: for name in values; do command; done

unsupported.diagnostic: unsupported Bash/Zsh construct: parameter or arithmetic expansion
unsupported Bash/Zsh construct: dialect conditional or arithmetic command
